CDKL5 encephalopathy; scoliosis occurs in 4/5. Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic; common constipation and reflux do not establish direct gastrointestinal injury.

Defining osteolysis, joint disease, skin atrophy and lipodystrophy with insulin resistance. Hepatomegaly alone and dental crowding do not establish additional organ injury.
Multiple familial trichoepitheliomas are cutaneous hair-follicle tumors, present in 13/13 patients.
Abnormal pulmonary venous connections and pulmonary arterial hypertension are cardiovascular. Respiratory symptoms do not establish direct lung injury.
Villous adenoma arises in and occupies the rectal mucosal glandular epithelium.
Plasmodium infection directly parasitizes and destroys erythrocytes. Hepatic parasite stages do not establish common functional liver damage.

Noninflammatory arterial wall dysplasia causes stenosis and aneurysms. Renal artery involvement is vascular; common kidney parenchymal injury is not established.

Acute inflammatory spinal gray-matter disease, usually associated with enteroviral infection; motor weakness reflects neuronal injury rather than primary muscle disease.
